gen-dafont-junegull-gf-fauna-one: The single-width trail of a rolling-ball pen defines Junegull, whose lowercase stands like cast iron capitals. And Fauna One, a text serif with a tall middle band, adds a literary, dignified counterweight.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-glegoo: Retro and friendly, Junegull pinches its curves nearly shut. Junegull is best at dense, rope-heavy punch, while Glegoo, a text serif with big counters, is best at opening every curve wide.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-kadwa: Kadwa, a text serif, brings open-ended curves throughout and a larger-than-usual x-height. Beneath Junegull's heavy, round-walled letters, paragraphs of it would move along smoothly, every curve left unclosed and inviting.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noticia-text: Noticia Text reads with a visible entrance into each curve and lowercase bodies filling most of the letter height. Junegull handles blunt display weight; Noticia Text handles the quiet, literary reading.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-piazzolla: Retro Junegull cuts its letters like strips of equal width, with every curve pinched closed. But Piazzolla, a serif with a lowercase nearly matching its capitals, opens its e like a pried clasp.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-scope-one: Counters that spill into the surrounding space make the body text read open and sturdy beside Junegull. Scope One, a text serif, opens up exactly where Junegull closes in.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-slabo-13px: Junegull cuts its display letters like a stencil, one steady width throughout, retro and friendly. And Slabo 13px, a text serif with large open counters in tall a, e and s, brings a bookish dignity.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-suwannaphum: A steady pen pressure from first letter to last gives Junegull its retro, friendly face. And shrink Junegull down and its pinched curves would crowd, while Suwannaphum, a serif, keeps a paperclip-open c.
gen-dafont-junegull-inter: Inter, a sans-serif with big counters in a tall lowercase, runs smooth and tube-like, line after line. Beside it, Junegull's closed, pinched letters look gloriously stubborn and a bit retro.
gen-dafont-lemon-milk-archivo: Archivo reads with curves that open outward and a commanding x-height, giving the text an editorial, approachable pull. Lemon Milk adds loose, wide tracking and rounded friendliness; body size can stay modest.
